title: Quantum Punish
description: All in One Punishment System | Jail Update
body:
# 🛑 QuantumPunish
### *Smart Moderation Suite for Modern Servers*

---

## ⭐ CORE FEATURES

### ⛓️ NEXT-GEN JAIL SYSTEM `[NEW]`
**Freedom isn't free.** Immersive **Labor-Based Jail** system.
* **Time-Pausing:** Sentences only tick down while the player is online.
* **Private Packet-Holograms:** Personalized info displays only visible to the prisoner.
* **Teleport Retries:** Automatic anti-escape system that drags players back.

### ⚖️ APPEAL SYSTEM
**Fairness for everyone.** Dedicated **Real-Time GUI** for staff to manage player unmute requests with a single click.

### 👁️ PUNISHMENT OVERSIGHT
**Keep track of everything.** Centralized **Management Interface** to monitor all active bans and mutes in one view.

### 🕵️ ALT DETECTOR
**Stop ban-evaders.** Receive **instant staff alerts** when a player joins using an IP linked to an active ban.

### 📜 ADVANCED HISTORY
**Review records with style.** Choose between a **Paginated GUI** or **Interactive Chat** with hoverable details.

### 🛡️ SMART CHAT FILTER
**Advanced detection engine.** Catches **leet-speak** and spamming techniques that bypass traditional filters.

### 🤖 AUTOMATED PUNISHMENTS
**Automation at its best.** Define **custom thresholds** to automatically trigger Kicks, Mutes, or Bans.

### 📱 DISCORD LOGGING
**Stay connected.** High-quality **Real-time Webhook logs** sent directly to your Discord channels.

---

## 🛠️ QUICK SPECS
* **IP-Based Sanctions:** Block players, not just accounts.
* **Zero-Setup SQLite:** Works out of the box with no database knowledge required.
* **100% Customizable:** Every message and prefix can be edited.
